entry.title: LXRXXL 0.6.1
entry.summary: > **0.6.0**: the sound engine is now the LXR-02's own, from the Erica Synths firmware Erica open-sourced (GPL-3.0): its > voices, filters, PWM, modulation and the real FX unit, plus its plate reverb (off in the hardware firmware). The > panel, randomizers, RESET, PARAMETERS column and pad control are unchanged. LXR-02 kits play as they do on the > machine, pulse width and FX modulation included. entry.title: LXRXXL 0.5.10
entry.summary: > **0.5.10** is 0.5.9 built on the latest wrapper and includes the Q-Link and automation fix (#486–#489): Q-Links now move parameters on the track's automation screen. Nothing else changed. Installs over 0.5.9 in place. LXRXXL for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC), armv7. Unzip, then follow INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod). `LXRXXL-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` is the plugin; `LXRXXL-<version>-source.zip` its complete source (required by the LXR02 Open-Source license: non-commercial use only)

entry.title: LXRXXL 0.5.9
